title: How Does Counterfactually Augmented Data Impact Models for Social Computing Constructs?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness and reliance on spurious gendered words in sexism detection tasks using counterfactually augmented data (CAD) that modifies gender identity terms.

Analyzing feature importance in hate speech detection models to determine if they rely on spurious racial identity terms and slurs, evaluated by using counterfactual data that alters identity words to test robustness.

Assessing hate speech detection models for reliance on religious identity terms (e.g., 'jew', 'muslims') as spurious features, evaluated through model performance on identity-based counterfactual data.
Measuring the reliance of hate speech classifiers on sexual orientation terms and slurs as spurious correlations, evaluated using counterfactual data augmentation targeting identity words.
